trigger.plain: An hourly candle closes over the prior day's high: the pivot break on expanding volume.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close back under structure_shift_ref, the break reversed.
decisions.reason: W swing_class HH/HL, ema_order 9>21 on W, D and H1; dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.63 so entry is at the pivot, no chase (C5). D swing_class LH/LL is the base's prior drift, not a failure. Tier-1 support_confirm 4, against_refute 2. Earnings, VCP count, 200d slope not served.

declarations: trend_template: MA-stack criteria read as served; criterion 3 (200d rising) NOT_SERVED; criterion 8 proxied by rs fields, not IBD rank
vcp_detail: NOT_SERVED (structure is a composite proxy only, C4)
earnings_growth: NOT_SERVED (C1 element 2, C12, C13, C20); fundamentals leg not run
